native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'servo1': '0 degrees', 'bargraph1': 'all LEDs off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, the servo motor is at 0 degrees and the LED bar graph is completely off.'}

test2: {'time': 'after pressing btn1', 'state': {'servo1': '30 degrees', 'bargraph1': 'first 3 LEDs on, remaining 7 LEDs off'}, 'description': 'Button 1 pressed. The servo motor rotates to 30 degrees, and the first 3 LEDs of the bar graph light up to indicate the angle.'}

test3: {'time': 'after pressing btn3', 'state': {'servo1': '90 degrees', 'bargraph1': 'all 10 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'Button 3 pressed. The servo motor rotates to 90 degrees, and all 10 LEDs of the bar graph light up to indicate the angle.'}

test4: {'time': 'after pressing btn2', 'state': {'servo1': '60 degrees', 'bargraph1': 'first 6 LEDs on, remaining 4 LEDs off'}, 'description': 'Button 2 pressed. The servo motor rotates to 60 degrees, and the first 6 LEDs of the bar graph light up to indicate the angle.'}

skipped_conditions.value: first 3 LEDs on, remaining 7 LEDs off
first 6 LEDs on, remaining 4 LEDs off

assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
